blocks.text: Digital Experience (ZDX) supports IPv6 configurations for secure and reliable access to applications. You can view dual-stack (IPv4 and IPv6) or IPv6-only.

blocks.item: Internet & SaaS (ZIA) to route and inspect IPv6 traffic for telemetry collection and for clients inside a location.
Zscaler Client Connector to forward and detect IPv6 traffic for clients outside a location.

blocks.text: To learn more, see Understanding IPv6 Support.
To begin viewing IPv6 details, you must enable IPv6 in the following:

blocks.item: Zscaler Client Connector: Enabling IPv6 Resolution for Zscaler Domains
